faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.subtitle: Everything you need to know about Docs Master Pro

items.q: Is my document uploaded to a server?
items.a: No. Docs Master Pro uses WebAssembly (WASM) engines to process everything locally in your browser's memory. Your files never leave your device — there are zero server uploads.
The tool supports DOCX, DOC, RTF, ODT, TXT, MD (Word), XLSX, XLS, CSV, ODS (Spreadsheets), PPTX, PPT, ODP (Presentations), PDF, JSON, XML, and HTML files.

items.q: Can I edit documents directly in the browser?
items.a: Yes! XLSX and CSV files can be edited cell-by-cell with a built-in spreadsheet editor. DOCX documents have a rich-text editing mode that lets you modify content and print or save.
When you enable the 'Scrub Metadata' toggle, the tool replaces author names, creation timestamps, editor history, and other personal identifiers from the exported file.

items.q: Can I extract specific pages from a PDF?
items.a: Yes. Use the PDF Page Extractor in the sidebar to specify which page you want, and the tool will export a single-page PDF using the pdf-lib WASM engine.

items.q: Does this work on mobile devices?
items.a: Yes. Docs Master is fully responsive and works on modern Android and iOS browsers, though the spreadsheet editor is best experienced on a larger screen.
